values: The outer-pedal area centroid in even-period elliptic billiards — Alec Kriebel, v1.0, 2026-10-13. Proof of k307 on the exact nonzero signed-area domain; explicit centroid and zero-area circle for some stars; all-M validity for simple even orbits. Independent reproduction and two fresh sequential adversarial preprint reviews passed. Bounded priority audit, original observation credited, no firstness certificate. AI tools used extensively; unrefereed, no external human peer review. Includes source and verification package.
